scientific_limits_from_saved_matlab_resu: The exploratory full-record COCO maximum is at 7 cm/kyr; the saved minimum rate-global p is 0.95. This is not evidence for a validated sedimentation rate.
The 405 kyr relative chronology is an imposed public prior. Its tuned spectral appearance is not independent confirmation; 210 Ma is an approximate orbital-target lookup age.
The 600/100 eCOCO map uses 14 complete, unpadded windows; rate-global correction applies within windows and is not map-wide. EvoFFT and eCOCO do not share the same edge-window policy.
The 19 simulations and 5 kyr interpolation step do not establish publication-level significance or independent temporal resolution.
